convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorLeManTrend indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for position management, requiring manual recreation of both the custom indicator logic and trading library functions

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation

other_exits: Sell position closed on buy signal (SELL_Close=true when UpValue[1]>DnValue[1] and SellPosClose enabled)
Buy position closed on sell signal (BUY_Close=true when UpValue[1]<DnValue[1] and BuyPosClose enabled)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM input: negative values interpreted as fixed lot size (absolute value), positive values interpreted as deposit fraction for deal sizing

custom_logic_notes: Signal detection uses bar[1] vs bar[0] comparison from CopyBuffer with SignalBar offset. When SignalBar=0, signals are checked on every tick without new bar guard. When SignalBar>0, signals only evaluated on new bar or recount. The crossover logic: UpValue[1]>DnValue[1] (current signal bar is bullish) AND UpValue[0]<=DnValue[0] (previous bar was bearish or neutral) triggers buy. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles position open/close with signal time tracking to prevent duplicate entries within the same bar period.
python_conversion_notes: Two external dependencies must be manually recreated: (1) ColorLeManTrend custom indicator - need to find/source its algorithm (LeMan Trend with 3 MA periods 13/21/34 smoothed by EMA period 3, outputting 2 buffers representing bullish/bearish trend values); (2) TradeAlgorithms.mqh - must reimplement BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, and CIsNewBar class. The crossover detection uses CopyBuffer with SignalBar offset: buffer[1] is the signal bar, buffer[0] is one bar before it. Position sizing is conditional on sign of MM parameter: negative=absolute lot size, positive=deposit fraction. SL/TP are in points (not pips), so digit adjustment depends on broker - no automatic adjustment detected in code. Signal timestamp (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) is used by TradeAlgorithms to prevent duplicate entries within the same bar.
